sources.title: Latency Optimization Techniques for Real-Time LLM Inference
sources.snippet: Achieving real-time latency for LLM inference requires optimizing every layer of the stack, from model selection and quantization through infrastructure deployment and prompt engineering.

sources.title: Reduce LLM latency with prefix-aware routing on Amazon SageMaker ...
sources.snippet: Amazon SageMaker Inference now offers prefix-aware routing, a routing strategy that sends requests sharing the same prompt prefix to the same instance so the KV cache stays warm. In benchmarks on Llama 3.1 70B, it reduced P50 time-to-first-token by up to 77% and raised KV cache hit rates from about 25% to over 80%.

sources.title: Formal schedulability analysis for LLM inference: TTFT and ... - Frontiers
sources.snippet: Abstract Introduction: Large language model (LLM) inference systems operate under strict latency service-level objectives (SLOs): a deadline on the first output token (TTFT) and a maximum inter-token interval (TBT). Real-time (RT) scheduling theory provides formal schedulability tests, worst-case response-time (WCRT) bounds, and admission control, yet existing LLM schedulers ignore these tools ...
